decisions.reason: Retaining the gallery hover animations does not change the source, quantity, or selection of portfolio images.
The hover-animation decision does not change the gallery categories, tabs, or optional photography area.
The pricing-table decision is expressed by a separate clause in the same message and already has its own Event; retaining gallery animations does not alter it.
Hover effects are independent of the requirement that viewers be able to scroll through the interactive gallery.
Retaining hover animations does not change the destinations or navigation behavior of the homepage buttons.
The gallery-animation decision does not alter the one-time pricing model or the visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
Retaining gallery hover animations does not change the presentation or selection of individually priced services.
The decision concerns hover behavior on gallery items and does not change the requirement for representative service images.
Gallery hover animations do not change the homepage hero overlay, opacity, or image emphasis.
Retaining gallery animations does not modify package counts, square-footage tiers, or displayed prices.
Hover animations may complement the visual presentation, but retaining them does not necessarily change the existing site-wide image-focused requirement.
The deferred quote calculator and its pricing logic are unrelated to gallery hover-animation behavior.
